meta.title: A Day in Da Nang | Marble Mountains, Son Tra Marina & Lady Buddha
meta.description:
Welcome to Da Nang, Vietnam – a city of stunning landscapes, rich culture, and unforgettable adventures! In this vlog, we explore the must-see attractions of Da Nang, from the majestic Marble Mountains to the serene Lady Buddha, before heading up to the magical Ba Na Hills.

In this vlog:
- Marble Mountains: Climb through ancient caves, pagodas, and enjoy panoramic views of Da Nang.
- Son Tra Peninsula (Lin Ung Pagoda): Visit the iconic Lady Buddha, the tallest in Vietnam, and soak in the peaceful vibes.
- Ba Na Hills: Experience the famous French Village  and breathtaking mountain views.

If you like this video or have any questions, feel free to leave us a comment and don't forget to like and subscribe, so you never miss an adventure!
